name: terminar
description: terminar - Persistent terminal sessions with web, electron, and VS Code extension frontends

scripts.server:dev: cd server && PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo run --bin terminar-server -- --no-auth
scripts.server:dev:mock: cd server && PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo run --bin terminar-server -- --no-auth --mock-pty
scripts.dev:tray: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n server,web,tray -c blue,green,magenta "pnpm server:dev" "pnpm wait-then:web" "pnpm wait-then:tray"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n server,web,tray,electron -c blue,green,magenta,yellow "pnpm server:dev" "pnpm wait-then:web" "pnpm wait-then:tray" "pnpm wait-then:electron"
scripts.build: pnpm server:build && cd web && pnpm build
scripts.test: cd server && cargo test && cd ../web && pnpm test
